description: Legal Point Discharge (Drainage Pt) is a dataset listed in City of Casey's Open Data Portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by City of Casey. This dataset shows stormwater drainage legal points of discharge outlets for properties in the City of Casey, extracted from the City of Casey's Asset Management System and GIS databases. Coverage: City of Casey, Victoria. The portal files it under Assets. Its keywords are Assets, Infrastructure, Drainage, Pipe, Pits, Stormwater. The portal shows 54,653 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-12-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 3. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-casey-vic-gov-au-portal.
